name: secure-transac-zk
description: ZK-SNARK circuits for SecureTransac trust score verification

scripts.verify: npx snarkjs groth16 verify artifacts/verification_key.json artifacts/public.json artifacts/proof.json
scripts.proof: npx snarkjs groth16 fullprove sample_input.json artifacts/trust_score_verifier_js/trust_score_verifier.wasm artifacts/trust_score_verifier_final.zkey artifacts/proof.json artifacts/public.json
scripts.copy: cp artifacts/trust_score_verifier.wasm ../frontend/public/zk/ && cp artifacts/trust_score_verifier_final.zkey ../frontend/public/zk/ && cp artifacts/verification_key.json ../frontend/public/zk/ && cp artifacts/TrustScoreVerifier.sol ../onchain/contracts/ && echo 'Artifacts copied to frontend/public/zk/ and onchain/contracts/'
scripts.dev: npm run build  && npm run copy
